metadata.description: Claude Code plugins by mpiccinnonode -- task triage, code review, and more

plugins.name: triage
plugins.description: Advisory task classifier that routes tasks to the best available skill, agent, or MCP server.

plugins.name: review-then-dry
plugins.description: Chained code-review + reuse audit producing one unified findings spec. Node-only, Windows-portable.

plugins.name: context-diet
plugins.description: Mod that trims session-start context: hides chosen skills from the listing and, by default, strips the superpowers gatekeeper. Needs Claude Code >= 2.1.287.

plugins.name: done-gate
plugins.description: Mod that flags (or blocks) a coding turn that edited sources without running the project's checks afterwards. Needs Claude Code >= 2.1.287.

plugins.name: capabilities
plugins.description: Answers "have we already built this?" by reading every CAPABILITIES.md in the GitHub org. For technical and non-technical colleagues.

plugins.name: buddy
plugins.description: Mod that brings back the /buddy companion: your original species, rarity, hat and stats, animated above the prompt, reacting to your work. Needs Claude Code >= 2.1.295.
